name_note: GTDB s__Bacteroides stercoris_A is one of several genome lineages labelled Bacteroides stercoris in NCBI; one genome in it is annotated Blautia wexlerae, which is a different organism.

sentences.text: Bacteroides stercoris is a gut bacterium detected in human faecal samples.
A study reported that faecal samples with a signature of low-to-none SARS-CoV-2 infectivity had higher abundances of short-chain fatty acid producing bacteria including Bacteroides stercoris.
In a study of type 1 diabetes, some ZnT8186-194-reactive CD8+ T cell clonotypes were found to cross-recognize a Bacteroides stercoris mimotope.
